auditFuzzAllCovered: Kowane aikin mai tsaftacewa / mai fassara da aka samu an ambace shi a gwajin kaddarori.
auditFuzzOutro: Rahoto kawai, babu abin da ya gaza. {command} yana rubuta gwajin fuzz na farawa don abu; {json} yana ba da rahoto da na'ura ke iya karantawa.
wcActionAddFuzzTest: Ƙara gwajin fuzz na farawa (na tushen kaddarori)
wcFuzzBadName: "{name}" ba sunan abu na musamman ba ne (ƙananan haruffa tare da layi, kamar my-element). Gudanar da wannan a cikin babban fayil na abun ko ba da --name.
wcFuzzNoElement: Babu {file} a cikin wannan babban fayil. Gudanar da wannan a cikin babban fayil na abun, ko ba da --name don wani abu na wannan aikin.
wcFuzzExists: {file} ya riga ya wanzu kuma an bar shi yadda yake (yi amfani da {flag} don maye gurbinsa).
wcFuzzConfigExists: {file} ya riga ya wanzu kuma an bar shi yadda yake. Gwajin fuzz yana gudana da tsayayyen seed nasa; don nema da seed na bazuwar ko maimaita gazawa, ba da masu canji HAX_FUZZ_* zuwa shafin gwaji daga wannan saitin.
wcFuzzDryRun: Gwaji: za a rubuta wannan (ba a rubuta komai ba)
wcFuzzNext: Gudanar da {install} don ƙara fast-check, sannan {test}. {hunt} yana nema da seed na bazuwar; gazawa tana buga seed da hanyar da ke maimaita ta.
wcFuzzNextMonorepo: Gudanar da {command} a cikin babban fayil na wannan abu. Neman fuzz na dare na monorepo yana ɗaukar fayilolin *-fuzz.test.js da kansa.
